supersedes.defect_explanation: For every component area_i >= 1, 4.0*sqrt(area_i) >= 4.0 >= 0.75, so the clip collapses the entire mapping to the historical fixed sigma = 0.75. The active H3 branch would have been IDENTICAL to baseline, producing a NULL experiment (no supply-diversity signal). Caught prospectively before any training.

train_only_audit.population: TRAIN FULL_FIELD only (kub_train_samples_sized.csv, 771 images); VAL/TEST untouched
train_only_audit.method: code-exact 128-space NEAREST subsample of the padded 512 mask (m512[::4,::4]); 8-connected labeling; per-component foreground pixel count
train_only_audit.a_ref_basis: p75 of TRAIN-only FULL_FIELD 128-space component areas
train_only_audit.note: Independent re-implementation of the runtime mask pipeline yields p75 ~= 12.0 (same order, <25% offset); frozen A_ref=14.0 retained per ruling. Non-degeneracy verdict is identical for either value.

corrected_mapping.space: A128_i = per-component foreground pixel count in 128-space heatmap space
corrected_mapping.semantics: Small components (small A128_i) -> smaller sigma -> sharper, higher-contrast peak (better tiny-object supply). Large components capped at sigma_max = 0.75 (historical behavior).

non_degeneracy_verification.verdict: SPREAD (14 distinct levels), NOT all at ceiling (23.3%), TINY median sigma < non-TINY median sigma. Non-degenerate.

covers: large-area component caps at sigma_max == historical fixed behavior
small-area component yields sharper peak than fixed sigma
